snippet.title: 猫曜日
snippet.description: 猫好き、家で動物と暮らす人、言葉の少ないリアクションが好きな人に向いています。朝の準備中、移動時間、昼休み、寝る前など、音を出せない場面でも理解しやすい表情と動きを大切にします。 季節と習慣を取り入れ、何度も戻れるシリーズを作ります。 縦型クリップでは数秒で状況がつかめる導入を置き、まとめ動画では似た展開が続かないよう場所、性格、オチの種類を切り替えます。 決まった日に顔を見たくなる、そんな親しみを育てます。「猫曜日」は、曜日ごとに会いたくなる定期便という発想で猫の自然な面白さを集めるエンタメチャンネルです。 毎回同じクリップを並べるのではなく、主役の性格が伝わる短い物語として編集します。季節や生活習慣も取り入れ、チャンネル全体に覚えやすい世界観を残しながら、更新ごとに違う温度の笑いを届けます。 誰かを困らせる悪ふざけ、危険をまねく行動、説明だけで笑わせる構成には頼りません。偶然のタイミングと素の反応を中心にし、初見ではオチ、見返すと背景の小さな変化を発見できる一本を目指します。 登場するのは突然の全力疾走、箱への無理な挑戦、飼い主への無言の要求、子猫の空振り、深夜のいたずらなど。かわいい場面だけに寄せず、変な癖、意外な判断、少し気まずい間、最後に心がほどける交流まで幅広く選びます。 気に入った主役や見逃していた合図があればコメントで教えてください。誰かを思い出した場面は共有して、次の記録を最初から楽しみたい方はチャンネル登録をお願いします。

snippet.title: UK Food Exposed
snippet.description:
UK Food Exposed cuts through the supermarket spin.

We investigate what's actually in the food British families buy, ingredient by ingredient and brand by brand. We look at what's changed, what's been downgraded, and what the packaging leaves out.

You'll find honest rankings of UK butter, bread, pasta, coffee, sauces and supermarket staples, based on public data, ingredient lists and verified reports, to help you stop overpaying for products that aren't what they used to be.

If you've ever stood in a supermarket aisle wondering when your favourite product stopped tasting the way it used to, you're in the right place.

Want to check the label yourself before your next shop? The UK Shopper's Guide to Reading the Label turns every investigation on this channel into something you can use at the till.
Get it here: https://publy.store/t/Aaf5fZP

Subscribe for regular investigations into the food Britain relies on every day.

General information only. Not medical or nutritional advice.

snippet.description:
We're here to help you gain knowledge about emergency preparedness, not just assemble a list of items to stock up on. We're here to help you prepare for all scenarios, long-term and short-term. snippet.title: Rogue Preparedness
snippet.description:
Howdy! My name is Morgan!

I'm a wife, and mother of three daughters. We have lived off grid in AZ, AK and have traveled full time in an RV. We currently live in the suburbs.

You know what? I don't want to see you survive. I want to see you THRIVE!

I'm tired of seeing how scared and fearful the prepping community is. Preparedness shouldn't come from a place a fear, nor should it stay there. Everyone should be prepared. 

Not because of the end of the world, but because bad things happen. 

We believe that Jesus is our Lord and savior. You know what, you're probably going to hear me mention God, Jesus and the Holy Spirit in all of my content. Because I do this because of Him. I am here because of Him. I am saved because of Him. He is the one true King and I will never be ashamed to worship and praise Him and spread the good news.
